decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-146 MODIFY already captures the revised founder share, fiat-fee deduction, and use of remaining proceeds for commissions and prize pools.
Deducting applicable fiat fees from the founder allocation does not change whether fiat buyers need wallets or the wallet requirements for commissions, tickets, or trading.
The source preserves funding of the Big Block pool and does not change its prize amount, trigger, eligible sales, funding persistence, or winner eligibility.
The revenue-allocation change does not alter Transak, accepted payment methods, conversion behavior, buyer access, or wallet and crypto prerequisites.
The source Event concerns primary-mint proceeds and applicable fiat-mint fees; it does not change the flat secondary royalty or its existing allocation to the founder and prize pools.
The founder-allocation and residual-proceeds decision does not change Big Block ticket issuance, ownership, weighting, eligibility, reset behavior, or wallet requirement.
The source preserves funding of the Small Block pool and does not change its prize values, activation condition, sales cadence, recurrence, or winner eligibility.
The primary-mint revenue allocation does not alter the metadata ticket counters, permanent badges, or mint-number referral-code attribute.
Although remaining proceeds fund commissions, the source does not change the no-referral commission amount, triggering condition, or random-holder recipient rule.
The source decision does not change Small Block ticket issuance, recipient, eligibility window, carryover, reset, weighting, or secondary-sale behavior.
The allocation of primary-mint proceeds does not change which NFT-associated rights, badges, referral identity, or active and expired tickets transfer on secondary sale.
Funding allocation does not change the Chainlink VRF provider, on-chain selection process, fairness properties, eligible population, weighting, or Basescan verification.
